remediation: Mask the number to its last four characters and keep the document in the vault.

fp: A blanked or masked voter number is not reported.
recordDesc: A voter id field holding a full document number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The voter number is an accepted identity proof for account opening, so a leak lets an attacker assemble a false identity with a genuine document reference.
applicability: Deployments that render a voter id field holding a full document number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The voter number is an accepted identity proof for account opening, so a leak lets an attacker assemble a false identity with a genuine document reference.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Mask the number to its last four characters and keep the document in the vault.
Mask the voter number and store the document in the identity vault.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a voter id field holding a full document number.
